title: QE pending template lifecycle lacks hard delete API, MCP tool, and UI button
description: GitHub Issue #114 was originally titled BUG-086, but local BUG-086 is already fixed for a different Paper v2 runtime-config issue. This record preserves the real open QE template hard-delete lifecycle bug under a new unique BUG ID.
expected: Pending QE templates that are draft, ready_for_review, or approved but not materialized/executed can be hard-deleted through guarded backend, MCP, and UI flows.
actual: Current main exposes supersede but no hard delete repository method, API endpoint, MCP tool, or UI delete action for pending templates.
closure_requirements: Guarded delete API and repository behavior implemented for non-executed pending templates.
MCP delete tool exposes explicit confirmation semantics.
UI delete button exists with confirmation and refresh behavior.
Executed/runtime history is not silently deleted.
evidence_uris: rg search found supersede-only current behavior on 2026-06-06

events.note: Renumbered GitHub Issue #114 from BUG-086 to BUG-277 because the previous BUG ID already exists locally with a different fixed issue.
